name: Xtream Library
overview: Sync Xtream VOD and Series content to native Jellyfin libraries via STRM files
description: Creates STRM files from your Xtream provider's VOD and Series content, enabling native Jellyfin library integration with full metadata support. Fork build.

versions.changelog: Stream limit: the message that a provider has no free stream is now shown as a dialog the user has to confirm, not as a transient notification.

Stream limit: streams are now counted from the sessions Jellyfin reports as playing, not from start events alone. A stream that began before a restart, or whose start was never reported, no longer lets another user past the limit, and a lost stop no longer keeps a slot.

Stream limit: the refusal message now reaches the user. Playback is refused before the player opens the stream, so a client no longer hangs on the loading animation when the provider is full, and the message is shown after the stop instead of being lost with the player screen.

Stream limit per provider: set a maximum number of simultaneous streams in each provider's settings. Playback beyond the limit is stopped and a configurable message is shown. The config page lists the streams playing right now.
